The face displays provider data; it does not independently record activity.
ONE PURCHASE
All themes are included. No ads, subscriptions, login or separate phone companion app. The watch face has no analytics or developer-operated data service.
GET STARTED
Install from Google Play to a compatible Wear OS watch. Touch and hold your current watch face, choose Add watch face, then select Dive Watch. Touch and hold again and choose Customize to change Watch theme, hands, dial finish or the lower data source. name: Kenai Report Data
summary: Fish counts, Soldotna river readings and Cape Kasilof tide complications.
listingDescription:
Kenai Report Data supplies fishing-report complications for compatible Wear OS watch faces, including Kenai Fishing Report.
This is the separate DATA APP, not a watch face. Install it on the same watch as your chosen compatible face, then select its providers in the complication settings. Kenai Fishing Report is available as a separate watch-face app. Kenai Report Data can also be used with other faces that accept its text complications.
READINGS
• ADF&G Kenai late-run sockeye: latest daily count, count date, and season total.
• USGS Soldotna: water temperature, with flow and gauge observations in details.
• NOAA Cape Kasilof: next predicted high/low tide, height and Alaska-local time.
• ADF&G rule-verification reminder and official source links.
Open the watch app or tap a Kenai complication to read its report and fetch time. Refresh requests updates immediately, with a short throttle to avoid repeated requests. Automatic complication update requests are approximately every 30 minutes and may be deferred by Wear OS. Forecast and observation availability depends on the source and your connection.
Reports are fetched directly over HTTPS and cached locally after successful validation. Old or failed readings are identified; missing values are never replaced with fabricated counts. Out-of-season fish counts may remain unchanged. The rules reminder does not decide whether fishing is permitted.
PRIVACY
No accounts, advertising SDKs, analytics SDKs, subscription, developer backend, location permission or health permission. Public reports and update status are stored on your watch. Government source servers receive normal network connection metadata, such as IP address and an app User-Agent, under their own privacy practices. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes the local cache. Read Privacy & sources inside the app for details.
Requires Wear OS 5 or later and internet access for updates. A watch browser is needed to open source websites directly; their URLs remain visible if no browser is installed. This app does not display a phone UI or provide fishing alerts.
OFFICIAL SOURCES
ADF&G Kenai late-run sockeye counts:
https://www.adfg.alaska.gov/sf/FishCounts/index.cfm?ADFG=main.displayResults&COUNTLOCATIONID=40&SPECIESID=420
USGS Kenai River at Soldotna, station 15266300:
https://waterdata.usgs.gov/monitoring-location/15266300/
NOAA Cape Kasilof tide predictions, station 9455711:
https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/stationhome.html?id=9455711
ADF&G emergency orders:
https://www.adfg.alaska.gov/sf/EONR/index.cfm?ADFG=Region.R2
INDEPENDENT APP
Tripper Dee Labs does not represent, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by, ADF&G, USGS, NOAA, the State of Alaska, or any government entity. Public information may be delayed, preliminary, revised, or unavailable. Fish passage is not a catch forecast. Cape Kasilof tides are predictions, not measured Kenai River levels. Always verify current fishing regulations, emergency orders, and local conditions.
Support: feedback@tripperdeelabs.com

Data availability depends on device sensors, system settings, permissions granted to providers, and installed apps. Missing readings may appear as dashes. The ring and steps number use the same native watch step count, with a goal chosen in Summit; it does not synchronize your health app goal. Automatic scenery uses fixed local-time periods, not calculated sunrise or sunset. Summit Line displays available heart-rate data; it does not initiate a measurement and is not a medical device. Mountain artwork is decorative and is not a navigation map.
No ads, accounts, or subscriptions. No separate Summit phone app is required.
